insurer: Niva Bupa Health Insurance Company Limited

room_rent.display: 1% of SI/day or Single Private Room (Classic); Single Private Room (Enhanced)
room_rent.note: Classic plan: 1% of Base SI per day or Single Private Room, whichever is lower. Enhanced plan: Single Private Room. Pro-rata clause applies if higher room taken.

icu.note: Classic plan: up to 2% of Sum Insured per day. Enhanced plan: covered up to Sum Insured (no cap).

copayment.display: 20% for Classic plan in Delhi NCR, Mumbai, Kolkata & Gujarat; None for Enhanced plan
copayment.note: 20% co-payment applies only under Classic plan for treatment in Delhi NCR, Mumbai (incl. Navi Mumbai & Thane), Kolkata and Gujarat State. No co-payment on ambulance, pharmacy, health check-up, PA, CI, e-Consultation, Hospital Cash.

sub_limits.display: Mental disorders 10% of Base SI or ₹50k; HIV/AIDS 10% of Base SI or ₹50k; Robotic surgery ₹1L (select types exempt)
sub_limits.note: Mental disorder sub-limit (10% Base SI or ₹50k) covers listed conditions. HIV/AIDS sub-limit same. Robotic surgeries capped at ₹1L except prostatectomy, cardiac, partial nephrectomy, malignancy surgeries. No sub-limits on most other conditions.

initial_waiting.note: Standard 30-day waiting period for illnesses; accidents covered from day 1.

ped_waiting.note: PED waiting period is 36 months from first policy inception. Reducible via portability credit.

specific_disease_waiting.note: Applies to listed conditions including cataract, hernia, osteoarthritis, kidney disease, varicose veins, benign tumours, etc. Accidents exempt from day 1; cancer after 30-day wait.

maternity.note: Maternity is a permanent exclusion (Code-Excl18). Ectopic pregnancy is covered.

cumulative_bonus.display: Up to 100% (10%/yr); optional Enhanced NCB up to 200% (20%/yr)
cumulative_bonus.note: Base: 10% of Base SI per claim-free year, max 100%. No reduction on claim. Enhanced NCB optional add-on: 20%/yr, max 200%.

restoration.display: Once/yr, 100% of Base SI (different illness only)
restoration.note: Re-fill benefit reinstates up to 100% of Base SI once per policy year for a different illness/injury. Cannot be used for same illness already claimed. Optional Enhanced Re-fill gives 150% of Base SI.

pre_hosp.note: Pre-hospitalisation expenses covered for 30 days preceding admission.

post_hosp.note: Post-hospitalisation expenses covered for 60 days after discharge.

day_care.note: Only procedures listed in Annexure IV (536 listed procedures) are covered as day care.

domiciliary.note: Covered up to Sum Insured; minimum 3 consecutive days; reimbursement basis only.

ayush.display: Covered up to SI (inpatient in AYUSH hospital)
ayush.note: Ayurveda, Unani, Siddha, Homeopathy covered for inpatient care in recognised AYUSH hospitals. Pre/post-hosp also covered.

organ_donor.note: Living organ donor harvesting expenses covered up to Sum Insured, subject to recipient's claim being admitted.

ambulance.note: Classic plan 3L/4L SI: ₹1,500 per hospitalisation. Classic 5L+: ₹2,000. Enhanced plan 3L/4L: ₹1,500; Enhanced 5L+: ₹2,000. One transfer per hospitalisation.

modern_treatments.note: 12 modern treatments covered including robotic surgery, stereotactic radiosurgery, oral chemo, etc. Robotic surgeries capped at ₹1L except prostatectomy, cardiac, partial nephrectomy and malignancy surgeries.

consumables.note: Consumables like gloves, masks, etc. are listed as non-payable in Annexure II. No consumables cover rider available.

global_cover.note: Policy explicitly states all benefits available in India only; treatment outside India is a specific exclusion (Section 6.2 XI).

moratorium.note: After 60 continuous months of coverage, no claim/policy contestable except on grounds of fraud.

grace_period.note: 15 days grace for monthly premium mode; 30 days for all other modes. Coverage available during grace period.

free_look.note: 30-day free look period from date of receipt of policy document; applicable on new policies only, not renewals.

portability.note: IRDAI-mandated portability with credit transfer for PED waiting, specific waiting periods, NCB and moratorium.

notable_exclusions.display: Maternity, hormone replacement therapy, STIs (non-HIV), sleep disorders, external congenital anomaly, dental (non-accident), treatment outside India, artificial life maintenance

optional_riders.display: Personal Accident Cover, Critical Illness Cover (20 CIs), e-Consultation (unlimited), Hospital Cash, Enhanced NCB (200%), Enhanced Re-fill (150%)
